mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE ancestry(resource_id) AS ( SELECT #{resourceId} UNION ALL SELECT rh.parent_resource_id FROM resource_hierarchy rh JOIN ancestry a ON rh.resource_id = a.resource_id WHERE rh.parent_resource_id IS NOT NULL ) CYCLE resource_id SET is_cycle USING path, my_groups(group_id) AS ( SELECT group_id FROM group_members WHERE user_id = #{userId} ) SELECT rg.role AS role, rg.resource_id AS resourceId, CASE WHEN rg.resource_id = #{resourceId} AND rg.user_id = #{userId} THEN 'direct' WHEN rg.resource_id = #{resourceId} THEN 'group' ELSE 'inherited' END AS source FROM resource_grants rg WHERE rg.resource_id IN (SELECT resource_id FROM ancestry) AND ( rg.user_id = #{userId} OR rg.group_id IN (SELECT group_id FROM my_groups) )

WITH RECURSIVE granted_roots(resource_id) AS ( SELECT rg.resource_id FROM resource_grants rg WHERE ( rg.user_id = #{userId} OR rg.group_id IN (SELECT group_id FROM group_members WHERE user_id = #{userId}) ) AND ( #{action} = 'VIEW' OR (#{action} = 'EDIT' AND rg.role IN ('EDITOR', 'ADMIN')) ) ), descendants(resource_id) AS ( SELECT resource_id FROM granted_roots UNION SELECT rh.resource_id FROM resource_hierarchy rh JOIN descendants d ON rh.parent_resource_id = d.resource_id ) SELECT DISTINCT resource_id FROM descendants
